feed.title: Local Transcriber – releases
feed.subtitle: New versions of Local Transcriber, a free, open-source Mac app that transcribes meetings, calls and dictation locally.

entry.title: Local Transcriber 0.16.1: the recording time counts seconds in the first minute
entry.summary: The menu bar shows seconds for the first minute of a recording, so you can see right away that it is running; after that it switches to minutes as in 0.16. Release notes: https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber/releases/tag/v0.16.1

entry.title: Local Transcriber 0.16: less load while recording, echo cancellation works again
entry.summary: Recording puts far less load on macOS (this prevents a display crash seen on macOS 27), echo cancellation with voice processing works again, and the menu bar shows the recording time in minutes. Release notes: https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber/releases/tag/v0.16

entry.title: Local Transcriber 0.15: memory leak fixed, short summaries fit the panel
entry.summary: The app stays lean even after days of running, short summaries fit the panel, and calls from a room with its own call computer are separated cleanly. Release notes: https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber/releases/tag/v0.15

entry.title: Local Transcriber 0.14: Homebrew upgrades no longer hang, panel fits the screen again
entry.summary: Homebrew upgrades no longer hang, and the panel fits the screen again after you unplug a monitor. Release notes: https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber/releases/tag/v0.14

entry.title: Local Transcriber 0.13: the real recording date, for the Obsidian plugin 0.3.0
entry.summary: The real recording date in every transcript – for the Obsidian plugin 0.3.0. Release notes: https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber/releases/tag/v0.13
